text:
**Sunday**, and the Read-a-thon starts **tomorrow**. Keep a book in your bag all week, so any spare ten minutes can count.

Tutoring is **Monday** and **Tuesday**. The SHINE lunch is **Wednesday**, the 4th grade field trip is **Thursday**, and **Friday** is the last day of fall clubs, so Little Medical School wraps up then.

Thanksgiving Break starts the week after. Tonight, pick the book you will start with and read a chapter before bed.
